protocol.instruction: Audit the proposed changes to this step's prospective action set, using only the visible conversation. The first set is the no-new-read decision; the second is the proposed decision after the tool reply. Review exactly the listed additions and removals. For each addition, require a concrete current trigger for the specific action, object and latest instruction. A related event or a nearby time is insufficient. The return may mix prior and new entries; do not treat every returned entry as a fresh event. Use the latest visible instruction and the exact time when an action requires one. Accept a removal only when the action lacks a current basis, was superseded, or conflicts with a better-supported action. Keep an independently supported action when another action becomes due. Do not assume the previously selected actions were all correct. Return only JSON with keys "add" and "remove". Each maps every listed handle for that operation to {"accept":true or false,"why":"brief visible evidence or reason"}. Use empty objects for empty lists. Never request a tool or propose any action outside the listed changes.
